fullPassage: Historical evidence points to workers being exploited by employers in the absence of appropriate laws. This means that workers are not always compensated for the contributions for their increased productivity ― as economic theory would suggest. Employers will be able to exploit workers if they are not legally controlled. Thus, the minimum wage laws may be the only way to prevent many employees from working at wages that are below the poverty line. This point of view means that minimum wage laws are a source of correcting for existing market failure, enhancing the power of markets to create efficient results.

det.korean: (A) exploited(착취당하는), (B) appropriate(적절한), (C) prevent(막다) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:

❌ ③ exploited — inappropriate — prevent: inappropriate(부적절한)는 appropriate의 반의어
❌ ④ exploited — appropriate — encourage: encourage(장려하다)는 prevent의 반의어
det.tip: exploited↔supported, appropriate↔inappropriate, prevent↔encourage

det.analysis:
❌ ① penalized — legally — efficient: penalized(처벌받는)는 compensated의 반의 개념
✅ ② compensated — legally — efficient: 원문 그대로. 생산성에 보상받고, 법적 통제가 필요하고, 효율적 결과 창출
❌ ③ compensated — freely — efficient: freely(자유롭게)는 legally와 문맥 불일치. 법 없이 자유롭게 착취 가능함을 암시
❌ ④ compensated — legally — inefficient: inefficient(비효율적인)는 efficient의 반의어
det.tip: compensated↔penalized, legally↔freely(맥락 반대), efficient↔inefficient

det.korean: (A) absence(부재), (B) poverty(빈곤), (C) correcting(바로잡는) — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
❌ ① absence — wealth — correcting: wealth(부)는 poverty의 반의어. 빈곤선이 아닌 부유선
❌ ② presence — poverty — correcting: presence(존재)는 absence의 반의어. 법이 있으면 착취 없으므로 맥락 불일치
❌ ③ absence — poverty — creating: creating(만드는)은 correcting의 반의 개념. 시장 실패를 '만드는' 게 아니라 '바로잡는' 것
✅ ④ absence — poverty — correcting: 원문 그대로. 적절한 법의 부재, 빈곤선 이하 임금, 시장 실패 바로잡기
det.tip: absence↔presence, poverty↔wealth, correcting↔creating(맥락 반대)

❌ ② 둘 다 가리키다: (B)의 'evidence points to'는 물리적 지시가 아닌 논리적 시사

workers are not always __________ (compensate) for the contributions.

det.korean: compensate(동사원형) → compensated(과거분사): be동사 뒤 수동태 구조. 'are compensated' = '보상받다'.
det.analysis: are not always + 과거분사 → compensated (수동태). '노동자들은 항상 보상받는 것은 아니다'.
det.tip: be compensated for ~ = ~에 대해 보상받다 (수동태). compensate → compensated(과거분사).

overlay.excerptSentences: This means that workers are not always __________ (compensate) for the contributions for their increased productivity ― as economic theory would suggest.

questions.passage: This point of view means that minimum wage laws are a source of __________ (correct) for existing market failure, enhancing the power of markets to create efficient results.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

a source of __________ (correct) for existing market failure.

det.korean: correct(동사원형) → correcting(동명사): 전치사 of 뒤에 동명사가 와야 함. 'a source of correcting' = '~를 바로잡는 원천'.
det.analysis: a source of + 동명사 → correcting (전치사 뒤 명사 역할). '시장 실패를 교정하는 원천'.
det.tip: of + V-ing: 전치사 뒤 동명사 필수. correct → correcting.

overlay.excerptSentences: This point of view means that minimum wage laws are a source of __________ (correct) for existing market failure, enhancing the power of markets to create efficient results.

questions.passage: Historical evidence points to workers being exploited by employers in the absence of appropriate laws. This means that workers are not always compensated for the contributions for their increased productivity ― as economic theory would suggest. Employers will be able to exploit workers if they are not legally controlled. Thus, the minimum wage laws may be the only way to prevent many employees from working at wages that are __________. This point of view means that minimum wage laws are a source of correcting for existing market failure, enhancing the power of markets to create efficient results.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: below the poverty line(빈곤선 이하) — 최저임금법이 없으면 많은 근로자가 빈곤선 이하의 임금을 받으며 일하게 된다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① above the legal standard: 법적 기준 이상, 최저임금법이 보호해야 할 상황과 반대
❌ ② at the market rate: 시장 임금 수준, 법적 보호 필요성을 약화시키는 표현
✅ ③ below the poverty line: 원문 일치 — 빈곤선 이하 임금이 최저임금법의 필요 이유
❌ ④ beyond their expectations: 기대를 넘어, 임금 수준 묘사와 무관
det.tip: prevent employees from working at wages below the poverty line — 빈곤선 이하 임금에서 일하는 것을 막는 것이 최저임금법의 목적.

questions.passage: Historical evidence points to workers being exploited by employers in the absence of appropriate laws. This means that workers are not always compensated for the contributions for their increased productivity ― as economic theory would suggest. Employers will be able to exploit workers if they are not legally controlled. Thus, the minimum wage laws may be the only way to prevent many employees from working at wages that are below the poverty line. This point of view means that minimum wage laws are a source of __________, enhancing the power of markets to create efficient results.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: correcting for existing market failure(기존 시장 실패 교정) — 최저임금법은 시장이 스스로 해결하지 못하는 실패를 바로잡는 수단이라는 본문 핵심 논점
det.analysis:
❌ ① enforcing strict penalties on employers: 고용주에게 엄격한 처벌, 본문의 '시장 교정' 논지와 방향이 다름
❌ ② limiting the freedom of the labor market: 노동시장 자유 제한, 최저임금법의 목적 설명 아님
❌ ③ increasing the bargaining power of workers: 노동자 협상력 증가, 언급되지 않은 메커니즘
✅ ④ correcting for existing market failure: 원문 일치 — 최저임금법 = 시장 실패 교정 수단
det.tip: a source of correcting for existing market failure — 이 문장이 본문 결론. 시장 실패 교정 기능이 핵심.
